verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's own docs say Workers fits into Git-based workflows and refer to a Workers Builds service, with a Builds MCP server and 'Worker build completing' events. That suggests a first-party build pipeline tied to Git, but the pack never documents connecting a repo or auto-detecting build settings. Missing for 10: documented repo-connect flow (GitHub/GitLab integration), automatic framework/build detection without manual configuration, push-to-deploy behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my app by simply connecting my repo without manual build configuration

citations.quote: Fits into your existing workflows: Git, GitHub Actions, VS Code, and any framework.
